cor.heading: Cost of Sales
cor.text:
A summary of our cost of sales is as follows (in thousands except percentages):

Cost of sales for the three months ended September 30, 2026, increased 23.4% to $646.2 million, from $523.7 million for the same period in 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Cost of sales was $1.7 billion, compared to $1.3 billion for the same period in 2025, primarily reflecting higher commission payments associated with agent growth and increased transaction volume.

rd.heading: Research and Development Expenses (“R&D”)
rd.text:
A summary of the components of our research and development expenses is as follows (in thousands, except percentages):

R&D expenses increased 37.9% to $6.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $4.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, R&D expenses were $17.0 million, compared to $12.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

ga.heading: General & Administrative Expenses (“G&A”)
ga.text:
A summary of the components of our G&A expenses is as follows (in thousands, except percentages):

G&A expenses increased to $60.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $19.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, G&A expenses increased to $99.7 million, compared to $56.0 million for the same period in 2025.

da_op.text: Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) before interest expense, interest income, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, further adjusted for the impact of certain items that are either non-cash in nature or that management does not consider indicative of ongoing operating performance. These adjustments may include equity-based compensation expense, restructuring expenses, acquisition-related expenses, transaction and integration costs related to acquisitions and mergers, settlement of litigation and impairment charges and related legal expenses, losses on extinguishment of debt, and other items that management does not consider indicative of ongoing operating performance. Adjusted EBITDA margin is calculated as Adjusted EBITDA divided by total revenue.

nonop.heading: Interest Expense
nonop.text: Interest expense was $5.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and $6.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, primarily reflecting interest incurred on debt issued in connection with the Transaction, including amortization of original issue discount and debt issuance costs.

tax.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded an income tax benefit of $16.2 million and $15.7 million, respectively, representing effective tax rates of 19.4% and 16.6%, respectively. The income tax benefit in 2026 is primarily attributable to a U.S. taxable loss generated by one-time transaction-related costs, partially offset by income tax expense in Canada, Israel, and India, where taxable income could not be fully offset by available tax loss carryforwards

net.text: Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) before interest expense, interest income, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, further adjusted for the impact of certain items that are either non-cash in nature or that management does not consider indicative of ongoing operating performance. These adjustments may include equity-based compensation expense, restructuring expenses, acquisition-related expenses, transaction and integration costs related to acquisitions and mergers, settlement of litigation and impairment charges and related legal expenses, losses on extinguishment of debt, and other items that management does not consider indicative of ongoing operating performance. Adjusted EBITDA margin is calculated as Adjusted EBITDA divided by total revenue.

ocf.heading: ​ Operating Activities
ocf.text: Cash flows generated by operating activities were $14.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a decrease from $65.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease was primarily driven by an increase in acquisition-related costs, severance related payments and timing of operating assets and liabilities.

capex.heading: Capital Expenditures
capex.text: We plan to continue to re-invest in our business in order to improve operational efficiencies and enhance the tools and services provided to our agents, franchisees and consumers.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text:
A summary of our revenue is as follows (in thousands except percentages):

Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026, increased 28% to $727.9 million, from $568.5 million for the same period in 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, total revenue grew to $1.9 billion compared to $1.5 billion for the corresponding period in 2025. The increase was driven primarily by growth in the Brokerage segment’s transaction volume, supported by an increase in productive agents, as well as the inclusion of approximately five weeks of REMAX operations following the Transaction.

intro.text: Real REMAX Group Inc. (the “Company ") is a technology-enabled global real estate services company engaged in residential real estate brokerage, real estate franchising, and other adjacent real estate services. On August 24, 2026, The Real Brokerage Inc. (“ Real ”) completed its acquisition of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. (“ REMAX ”), and, pursuant to the merger agreement governing the acquisition, both Real and REMAX became subsidiaries of the Company, which was a newly formed holding company (the “ Transaction ”). See Note 5, Acquisitions , for additional information. Under the Real brand the Company operates a digital real estate brokerage platform throughout the United States (“ U.S. ”) and Canada. Revenue from these operations is generated primarily from commissions earned on real estate transactions.
